label: Structured findings: 17 code files, 63k tokens — the case that falls to the diff-only rung

origin.note: Estimated at 63,441 tokens against a 54,016 threshold on a 58k window, so this is the one case that exercises the ladder’s second rung rather than whole files.

defects.description: `key in properties` walks the prototype chain, so an extra key named constructor, toString or valueOf passes the identity check that is the whole proof a reasoning-channel payload is not a scratchpad draft.
defects.anchor: if (schema.additionalProperties === false && Object.keys(value).some((key) => !(key in properties))) return false;

defects.description: extractJson anchors on the first "{" in the reply. A degraded reply that quotes source before its JSON has the quoted brace swallow the anchor, and good findings are discarded as a bad shape.
The degraded retry is announced before the context guard runs again, so a size refusal arrives right after "Retrying without it" and blames the diff for a request that was never sent.
defects.anchor: process.stderr.write(`${profile.name} rejected response_format (${error.message}). Retrying without it.\n`);
